incident-bot: [P1] SmartRouting alert: repeated fallback loop detected for customer 'AtlasMaps' on requests that include function calls. Auto-paging on-call.
Raj: Oncall here. Getting a flurry of 504s and increased retries for AtlasMaps. Paging @Mei and @Carlos. :rotating_light:
Mei: I'm in. Do we have a sample request ID from the alert stream? 
support-bot: Customer report: AtlasMaps request id atlas-2c3d5 failed at 11:02:07Z with repeated timeouts; they reported missing location enrichment from tool integration.
Raj: Pulling router traces for atlas-2c3d5. Early pattern shows bounce between regions with different variants. Snippet:
```
2026-04-02T11:02:07Z router[shard3] req=atlas-2c3d5 select=us-west-2 variant=redwood-13b-quant_int8_v4 -> err=toolcall_not_advertised
2026-04-02T11:02:08Z router[shard3] req=atlas-2c3d5 fallback=eu-central-1 variant=redwood-13b-fp16_v2 -> err=context_truncation
2026-04-02T11:02:09Z router[shard3] req=atlas-2c3d5 fallback=us-west-2 variant=redwood-13b-quant_int8_v4 -> err=toolcall_not_advertised
```
Mei: Looks like the quantized variant in us-west-2 is flagged as not supporting function calls, while it should. Meanwhile the fp16 variant in eu-central is unable to satisfy the context length and we get a flip-flop.
Carlos: Checking compatibility service: GET /compat/models/redwood-13b-quant_int8_v4?region=us-west-2 returns:
```
model: redwood-13b-quant_int8_v4
supports_function_calls: "false"
max_context_tokens: 8192
precision: int8
region: us-west-2
```
Carlos: That "false" is wrong  we promoted function-call support for this quant build last month. Seems ingestion didn't pick up a capability header.
Raj: Customer impact: AtlasMaps' pipeline uses function calls to enrich POIs. They're seeing partial responses and long tail retries, causing API errors on their side. Need fast mitigation.
Mei: Mitigation plan:
  1) Apply customer-specific override to pin AtlasMaps to redwood-13b-fp16_v2 in eu-central-1 for critical sessions
  2) Disable cross-region fallback for smart-route for 45m while we patch compat data
  3) Hotfix compat-matrix entry for redwood-13b-quant_int8_v4 to supports_function_calls=true and invalidate caches
Raj: I'll take 1) now. Running admin override:
```
POST /admin/routing/overrides
{ "customer": "AtlasMaps", "route": "smart-route", "pin_variant": "redwood-13b-fp16_v2", "region": "eu-central-1", "ttl": "45m" }
```
OpsLead: Override applied by Raj: 200 OK. Noted in change log.
support-bot: Notified AtlasMaps support contact that we applied a routing mitigation and are investigating root cause. Provided interim ETA 30m.
Carlos: I'll prepare the matrix correction. Hypothesis: CSV ingestion dropped the `supports_function_calls` column for quant rows when encountering a malformed newline in one model's metadata. Pushing a one-line parser fix.
deploy-bot: Starting compat-matrix patch deploy to staging for quick validation.
Mei: Before we reload, flip router policy for smart-route: `allow_capability_fallback=false` to prevent oscillation while data stabilizes.
Raj: Patching route policy:
```
PATCH /admin/routes/smart-route
{ "allow_capability_fallback": false }
```
Raj: Policy change applied; ops audit logged.
Carlos: Hotfix applied to compat ingestion; applying manual override for model entry now:
```
PATCH /compat/models/redwood-13b-quant_int8_v4
{ "supports_function_calls": "true" }
```
Carlos: Cache invalidation triggered: `kubectl exec compat-cache -- /app/invalidate redwood-13b-quant_int8_v4 --region us-west-2`
Mei: Observing router logs after reload. Sample success record:
```
2026-04-02T11:18:41Z router[shard3] req=atlas-9f1b selected=us-west-2 variant=redwood-13b-quant_int8_v4 -> status=200 function_call=ok latency=320ms
```
Mei: Tool calls are now completing successfully and error rates for AtlasMaps dropped back to baseline in telemetry.
Raj: Keep override for the TTL and monitor for 15 more minutes then remove if stable.
support-bot: AtlasMaps support acknowledged and asked for postmortem. They reported client-side latency spike ~11:02-11:20 with partial enrichments.
Carlos: Root cause: ingestion pipeline didn't validate presence of capability flags; a malformed metadata row for a different model triggered a shift in CSV parsing which silently omitted function call flags for quant rows. Will add schema validation and unit tests.
Mei: Additionally proposing router hardening:
  - Treat capability mismatch for function calls as terminal (don't fallback) to avoid oscillation
  - Add metric fallback_loop_count and alert when >3 in 1 minute
  - Add circuit-breaker to disable fallback for route during detected loop
Raj: Oncall handoff: Mei, my shift ends in 40m. Can you take monitoring after I go? 
Mei: Yep I'll take it. Please put the incident ID on the ticket and add notes.
OpsLead: Created INC-2026-410. Severity P1. Postmortem requested and assigned to infra/compat-ingest team.
Carlos: Audit scheduled: running `python infra/tools/compat_audit.py --since=2026-03-01` to find any other missing flags. Will post results.
Raj: Removing temporary override now (ttl expired)  verified routing returned to smart-route and toolcalls stable.
Carlos: Audit found 4 other region-specific rows where capability flags were inconsistent due to quoting edge-cases. Opening infra/compat-ingest#513 for fixes + backfill.
support-bot: Logged a customer-facing incident note and set expectation for an EOD summary. AtlasMaps requested a timeline for root cause and mitigation steps.
Mei: Added follow-ups: parser schema validation, ingestion unit tests, router loop-detection, fallback metrics. Will draft postmortem and link infra/compat-ingest PRs.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-410 updated: assigned to infra/compat-ingest. Next steps: postmortem due in 72h.
OpsLead: Handing monitoring to Mei. Last update 2376543380. If error rates resurface, re-open the pager. :thumbsup:
